instruction: Access the Virginia DMV site and locate the section outlining the requirements for applying for an ID card.

metadata.explanation: This task requires navigating the Virginia DMV website to find information about ID card application requirements. The evaluator checks that the final URL matches the ID card application page pattern. Similar to the original task in complexity (simple navigation), but focuses on ID cards instead of driver's licenses.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the navigation instruction: the task requires reaching the Virginia DMV ID card application page
Getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) correctly extracts the active tab URL from the accessibility tree's address bar
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly applies regex pattern matching to verify the URL
Expected regex pattern '^https://(www\.)?dmv\.virginia\.gov/licenses-ids/id/applying' accurately matches the ID card application page and allows both www and non-www variants
Complete coverage: the evaluator checks the only requirement in the instruction (reaching the correct page)
Logic is sound and will work correctly at runtime: getter can access accessibility tree, metric correctly handles both string and dict URL formats
